observation_or_reference_choice: Downward-pointing open triangular loop, nearly horizontal roof, left overshoot, heavy left stroke, fine right leg to short thick foot. Two detached short oblique dabs high. Minute lower-right speck seems separate.
Broad triangular wedge, horizontal upper edge, pointed left end, low point right of center, triangular opening. Two detached oblique marks. Irregular or hooked lower point uncertain.

Pointed high tent, long rising left stroke, heavier descending stroke folds into baseline terminating in narrow loop. A tiny diagonal descends through the baseline near its right end. No clear detached mark. Matches B/C, especially C, by thin downstroke at terminal loop.

High triangular apex, low baseline continuing into enclosed elongated loop, thin oblique stroke down-left from loop junction. No clear detached upper mark. Closest to B, C also close. Joins uncertain.

Three groups: curling x-like figure with upper hook, enclosed right loop, possible detached lower-left dab; touching double oval; then sinuous upright curve and bottom foot. First group somewhat closer to B/C by lower-left bead; more tentative than f08.

Three groups: curved hook into lower-right loop, faint lower-left continuation and separate dot; second a tilted two-opening figure; third a low leftward foot with curved upper cap. First group closer to D, A plausible, from fine oblique extension. Connection to left dot unclear.
Left arch open to left, heavy lower-left bead, center joins small right loop, no clear straight diagonal or detached mark. Closest to C among B/C.
Broad arch from left tip descends to center and joins closed right loop. Curved lower-left stroke ends in rounded terminal. Closest to C, also B.
A/D. Thin diagonal crosses the pen body, rising upper-right and continuing lower-left. Additional small loop on left makes less certain.
A. Crossed diagonal through the central body and right loop, with apparently enclosed left area and stronger crossing than the card.
B/C, likely C. Hooked bottom-left foot.
B, C also similar. Open left arch and lower-left terminal joined to a thick center and right loop.
B/C nearer C. Long rounded arch and black foot, small gap at right.
C, possibly B. Open arch, rounded lower-left terminal, right loop and tapered lower-right stroke.
B/C nearly B. Broad bottom-left curl, no diagonal.
B with C plausible. Thick central junction, upper-left arch and flattened lower-left terminal beside the right loop.
A, D a close alternative. Fine rising slash crosses the heavy descending central stroke. Larger right loop and additional small left eye.
B tentatively. Short upper-left hook, long lower-left return with bulbous tip, compact opening.
C. Long upper-left arch, recessed lower-left terminal, relatively open horizontal right loop.
B tentatively over C. Thickened lower-left terminal reaches as far as upper tip, small compact right loop and dark central join.
